General.title: General actions and conditions
General.drawShield: Draw the attack and block with your own shield
General.applicableHelp: Select applicable help (Ctrl/Cmd to select several)
General.SpecialistRequired: This damage requires specialized treatment before it can be restored.
General.confirmTreatment: Has appropriate specialized treatment been completed? Ending this restriction permits healing; it does not itself restore damage.
General.trackDisease: Track this ongoing disease for daily defenses (disease only)
General.dayPassed: Has a day passed since the previous disease defense?
General.drawRoll: Draw a determined foe's attack (Intellect task)
General.take: Take the attack if the defense fails
General.preventAction: Guard prevented the next declared action
General.manualDuration: End explicitly when the declared duration is over
General.conditionHint: Choose the duration established by the effect. Dazed usually lasts about a round. Paralysis permits actions requiring no physical movement; other unusual effects require GM adjudication.
General.cooperationHint: Use only one cooperative mode per task or attack. Declare applicable training for Help. A complementary task grants one asset on success. Distraction is limited to one step. Guarding must be active before stopping a foe.
General.incomingHint: Choose only one mode. Taking the attack transfers its consequences plus a minor wound only if the original defense fails, once until the interceptor's next turn.
General.singleTarget: Target exactly one actual character or NPC token first.
General.noPhysicalMovement: This action requires no physical movement
General.specialDamageHint: Enter the GM-declared consequences. Wounds, Pool damage and a condition can apply together. Repeat disease defenses each day. Declare separately if damage requires specialized treatment.
General.ActionPrevented: A current condition or guarding prevents this action. Defenses remain available while stunned.
General.GuardStopped: The guard stopped the declared action; the foe's action is lost.
General.ManualCorrection: This effect has a partially completed correction. The GM must reconcile it before it can be applied again.
General.Taken: {name} takes the attack and an additional minor wound.
General.DefenseSuccess: The defense succeeds; the declared effects are avoided.
